sections.heading: Summary
paragraphs: The file describes how the node admission ticket (VAT) collection (per the file) described in SIMD 326 is to be implemented. Per the file, the node admission ticket is a (per the file) mechanism translating the current (per the file) cost of voting into (per the file) a similar economic equilibrium for Alpenglow. Per the file, by charging every voting node 1.6 SOL per epoch, (per the file) it replaces the current voting (per the file) fee at ~2 SOL per (per the file) epoch, and reduces the likelihood (per the file) there are too many voting nodes immediately after Alpenglow launches.

Per the file, the general VAT concept (per the file) has already been accepted (per the file) with the governance vote on SIMD 326. sections.heading: Motivation
paragraphs: Per the file, adding more staked nodes to a blockchain does come with costs. Per the file, at the very least, (per the file) the votes and corresponding (per the file) rewards need to be (per the file) processed by every voting node. Per the file, therefore, every additional staked node increases the number of messages for every node. Per the file, right now every voting node pays voting fee on any vote tx included in a block. Per the file, the voting fee adds (per the file) up to ~2 SOL (per the file) per epoch if the node votes most of the time.

Per the file, it is a burden, (per the file) yet at the same (per the file) time it's an economic (per the file) barrier to having too many voting nodes. Per the file, vAT is only a (per the file) temporary solution to maintain (per the file) the current economic equilibrium. The file intentionally strives to keep voting node protocol costs similar to pre-Alpenglow consensus. Those statements are the file’s claims, not a Sol.College measurement of a live cluster.

Per the file, this is to be the acct where the VAT is deducted from. Per the file, identity acct: It continues receiving block (per the file) rewards and priority fees. sections.heading: How to implement the checks
paragraphs: Per the file, when a new bank (per the file) crosses an epoch boundary (per the file) (bank.epoch() > parent_bank.epoch()), calculate the (per the file) participating staked nodes for the next epoch (bank.epoch() + 1). Per the file, perform stake activation and (per the file) deactivation so that the (per the file) intended stake values are (per the file) used for the new epoch. Per the file, this operation occurs before any txs are processed in the (per the file) new epoch’s bank.

Per the file, the calculation iterates all vote accts and filters those that (per the file) meet the following criteria: The acct has a balance of (per the file) at least VAT plus (per the file) the necessary storage rent (per the file) amount for a new epoch The acct has a BLS public key If the number of filtered accts exceeds 2,000, sort them (per the file) according to the following rules (per the file) and select the top 2,000. Per the file, otherwise, return the entire (per the file) list: Sort in descending (per the file) order of stake (largest (per the file) to smallest) Do not tiebreak.

Per the file, if total valid vote accts exceed the limit of 2000, omit all accts whose stake is equal (per the file) to that of the 2001st acct Subtract VAT from the vote acct for each node in the accepted list (per the file) from the previous step Record the VAT fee (per the file) subtraction in the bank, (per the file) move the lamports directly into the incinerator acct. paragraphs: Per the file, have all nodes send a tx to deduct VAT every epoch. Per the file, a few problems with this approach: This tx must land before the staked nodes are selected If this node ends up not being (per the file) selected, this VAT fee (per the file) needs to be returned, (per the file) which means we have (per the file) to implement some type (per the file) of accounting and ensure (per the file) the VAT fee returning (per the file) properly lands on the chain.

sections.heading: Security Considerations
paragraphs: Per the file, keeping funds in vote accts for VAT is safer (per the file) than keeping funds in identity accts. Per the file, because the keypair for identity acct needs to be in (per the file) a hot wallet to support real-time node operations, while the vote authorized withdrawer keypair fails to need to be in a hot wallet. Per the file, in furtherance of improving (per the file) operational security, a future (per the file) simd may change the deposit location of node rewards to the vote acct.
